name: Skill Factory
description: A skills-only OpenClaw plugin: an eval-driven Skill Factory bundling skill-generator, skill-assessor, skill-splitter, a TDD/eval engine (skill-factory-eval) with static fast-path + dynamic trigger benchmark & auto description optimization, a screenshot-input bridge, and an end-to-end orchestrator to continuously produce, assess, split, benchmark and govern Agent Skills. Aligns with Anthropic skill-creator and outperforms it on dependency-freeness, speed and ecosystem governance.

registryPath.description: Path to the governance registry JSON. Only records verified skill versions; never affects runtime eligibility.

stagingDir.description: Directory where generated skill candidates are staged before authorized install.

assessorPassScore.description: Minimum skill-assessor STATIC score (0-100) required before a candidate may proceed to dynamic eval.

fastPathMinScore.description: Minimum static_trigger_score (0-100) from skill-factory-eval fast-path; below this, refeed the generator with zero model calls instead of running expensive dynamic eval.

evalPassTarget.description: Minimum precision AND recall (0-1) on the eval TEST set required to mark a skill's triggering as verified.
